headline: Hims and Noom move into unapproved peptide drugs
pages: Telehealth firms Hims & Hers and Noom are expanding into synthetic peptides, drugs long popular with bodybuilders and marketed for muscle, intimacy and longevity. Hims unveiled a Peptides+ program on Thursday, and Noom announced its own offerings this week. Both are eyeing BPC-157 and TB-500, two of six unapproved peptides that a new HHS policy lets compounding pharmacies produce, a decision made over concerns from agency staff scientists. Hims says it will add twice-yearly blood tests for monitoring. The companies argue their products will be safer than black-market versions.
Critics say selling drugs that have not been shown safe or effective for these uses could reach many patients who would not otherwise encounter them. Source: STAT News.
